name: DisGeNET_search_gene
description: Search DisGeNET for diseases associated with a gene. DisGeNET is the largest public database of gene-disease associations. Returns diseases, association scores, and evidence counts. Use the 'gene' parameter (e.g., 'BRCA1', 'TP53') — note: parameter name is 'gene', not 'gene_symbol'. Requires DISGENET_API_KEY env var (register free at disgenet.org).

assoc_id.description: DisGeNET's id for this association, which its chemical and evidence endpoints take

gene_uniprot_ids.description: UniProt accessions for the gene, for joining to protein-level sources

gene_dsi.description: Disease Specificity Index: low means the gene is associated with many diseases

gene_pli.description: gnomAD pLI, probability of loss-of-function intolerance

gene_symbols.description: Every gene the row names. A /vda/summary row spells this geneSymbol_keyword and a /gda/summary row symbolOfGene; reading only the GDA spelling returned null on every variant result.

gene_ncbi_ids.description: NCBI gene ids as the row lists them

gene_protein_classes.description: What kind of protein the gene codes for: Enzyme, Transcription factor, GPCR

disease_vocabularies.description: The disease's ids in every other vocabulary DisGeNET maps -- MONDO, DO, MeSH, ORDO, NCI -- which is what lets the association be joined to another source

disease_classes.description: The disease's classification in four schemes

score_breakdown.description: What the score is made of: per component (curated, clinical, inferred, models, literature) the contributing sources, their count and their weight. A 1.25 is then readable rather than taken on faith.

n_chemicals_in_evidence.description: How many chemicals appear in the evidence. The chemicals themselves are NOT returned -- BRCA1 answers 727 of them with 3,206 cross-references -- so query DisGeNET's chemical endpoints with assoc_id for the list.

year_first.description: Year of the earliest supporting publication

ei.description: Evidence Index: agreement among the publications

el.description: Evidence Level, where DisGeNET assigns one

disease_inheritance.description: How the disease is inherited, e.g. Autosomal dominant. DisGeNET writes an unknown value as an empty string; this is null then.

disease_prevalence_type.description: Whether the prevalence is point prevalence, birth prevalence or annual incidence

chromosome.description: Variant-disease results only: chromosome the variant is on

hgvs_c.description: Variant-disease results only. NOT paired with alternate_alleles: rs1801133 has three alternate alleles and two HGVS strings, so pairing by position would attach one allele's notation to another.

hgvs_p.description: Variant-disease results only; see hgvs_c on pairing

protein_changes.description: Variant-disease results only. Every transcript's numbering of every allele, sorted: 12 labels for rs113488022's 3 alleles, naming V157, V299, V600 and V640 for the same substitution. A set of names for the variant, not a per-allele list.

allele_frequencies.description: Variant-disease results only. gnomAD frequencies paired with alternate_alleles, which the two lists match in length on every variant checked. Null when the lengths disagree, rather than guessing the pairing.

allele_frequency_exome.description: Variant-disease results only, as DisGeNET sends it. -1.0 means gnomAD never observed the allele and is reported as null.

allele_frequency_genome.description: Variant-disease results only; -1.0 becomes null as above

variant_dsi.description: Variant-disease results only: Disease Specificity Index of the variant

variant_dpi.description: Variant-disease results only: Disease Pleiotropy Index of the variant

DISGENET_API_KEY.purpose: Pull curated gene–disease association scores and supporting evidence.
DISGENET_API_KEY.without: Limited public data works without it; the key unlocks full access.

name: DisGeNET_search_disease

name: DisGeNET_get_disease_genes
description: Get all genes associated with a disease from DisGeNET. Returns ranked gene list with association scores and evidence counts. Filter by minimum score to get high-confidence associations. Useful for disease gene prioritization.

disease.description: Disease ID (UMLS CUI) or disease name

min_score.description: Minimum association score (0-1). Default: no filter

dsi.description: Disease Specificity Index: low means the gene is associated with many diseases, so a hit on this list is less specific

pli.description: gnomAD pLI, probability of loss-of-function intolerance

n_pmids.description: Publications supporting the association. This is the field the tool returns; an earlier schema named it evidence_count, which nothing ever set.

assoc_id.description: DisGeNET's id for this gene-disease association, which its chemical and evidence endpoints take

protein_classes.description: What kind of protein the gene codes for

score_breakdown.description: What the score is made of, per component: the contributing sources, their count and their weight. 0.8 from two curated sources and 0.8 from text mining are not the same claim.

year_first.description: Year of the earliest publication supporting the association

year_last.description: Year of the latest. 2,248 papers ending in 1998 is a different candidate from 2,248 ending this year.

disease_name.description: The disease the code resolved to, as DisGeNET names it. A caller who passed the wrong CUI could not tell from the gene list alone.

disease_vocabularies.description: The disease's ids in MONDO, DO, MeSH, ORDO, NCI and the rest

disease_classes.description: The disease's classification in four schemes

disease_code.description: The disease identifier the query resolved to, e.g. 'UMLS_C0006142'.
